explication: XiaoZhi is embedded voice-chatbot firmware: a user speaks to a supported device, which captures and processes audio, communicates with a large-model service, and presents spoken or visual responses. Device-side MCP tools also let models control hardware. The graph combines the sampled application/audio calls and SOURCE INDEX references with README-documented capabilities; unsampled display, camera, networking, and provisioning internals are represented at their supported source paths, without asserting their internal call chains.
